lessons.title: The Journalist Who Refused to Be Silenced
lessons.titleNative: La periodista que se negó a callar
lessons.context: A journalistic-style narrative using formal register and discourse markers.

paragraphs.es: Afirmó la periodista que, so pena de perder su trabajo, jamás dejaría de investigar el caso.
paragraphs.en: The journalist stated that, on pain of losing her job, she would never stop investigating the case.

paragraphs.es: Cabe destacar que sus reportajes habían expuesto ya varios casos de corrupción en la región.
paragraphs.en: It's worth noting that her reports had already exposed several cases of corruption in the region.

paragraphs.es: En aras de proteger a sus fuentes, se negó rotundamente a revelar de dónde obtenía su información.
paragraphs.en: For the sake of protecting her sources, she flatly refused to reveal where she got her information.

paragraphs.es: A pesar de las amenazas recibidas, en tanto continuaba su investigación, jamás bajó la guardia.
paragraphs.en: Despite the threats received, while continuing her investigation, she never let her guard down.

paragraphs.es: Publicando finalmente el reportaje completo, logró que las autoridades abrieran una investigación oficial.
paragraphs.en: By finally publishing the full report, she managed to get authorities to open an official investigation.

questions.question: What did the journalist state?
options: She agreed with the corrupt officials

questions.question: What had her reports already exposed?
options: Cases of corruption in the region

questions.question: Why did she refuse to reveal her sources?
What did she achieve by publishing the report?

lessons.title: A Village's Old Saying
lessons.titleNative: El viejo refrán de un pueblo
lessons.context: A folkloric story using idiomatic expressions naturally.

paragraphs.es: En aquel pueblo, todos conocían el dicho: camarón que se duerme se lo lleva la corriente.
paragraphs.en: In that town, everyone knew the saying: the shrimp that falls asleep gets carried away by the current.

paragraphs.es: Cuentan que un joven, ignorando por completo el consejo de sus mayores, perdió una oportunidad única.
paragraphs.en: They say a young man, completely ignoring his elders' advice, lost a unique opportunity.

paragraphs.es: Metió la pata al no presentarse a tiempo a la reunión que decidiría el futuro de su negocio.
paragraphs.en: He messed up by not showing up on time to the meeting that would decide his business's future.

paragraphs.es: No hay mal que por bien no venga, sin embargo, ya que aquel fracaso lo empujó a reinventarse por completo.
paragraphs.en: Every cloud has a silver lining, however, since that failure pushed him to completely reinvent himself.

paragraphs.es: Hoy, aquel mismo joven cuenta la historia como ejemplo de que más vale tarde que nunca.
paragraphs.en: Today, that same young man tells the story as an example that it's better late than never.

questions.question: What did the old saying warn about?
What mistake did the young man make?
options: He didn't show up on time to an important meeting

questions.question: What did the failure push him to do?
What does he say today about the experience?

paragraphs.es: Érase un poeta cuya obra reflejaba, con una honestidad brutal, las tristezas de toda una generación.
paragraphs.en: There once was a poet whose work reflected, with brutal honesty, the sorrows of an entire generation.

paragraphs.es: Escribiendo hasta sus últimos días, jamás dejó de buscar la palabra exacta para cada emoción.
paragraphs.en: Writing until his final days, he never stopped searching for the exact word for every emotion.

paragraphs.es: Cabe destacar que su último poema, publicado póstumamente, se convirtió en un símbolo de esperanza.
paragraphs.en: It's worth noting that his last poem, published posthumously, became a symbol of hope.

paragraphs.es: No cabe duda de que su legado perdurará mientras existan lectores dispuestos a sentir con tanta profundidad.
paragraphs.en: There is no doubt that his legacy will endure as long as there are readers willing to feel so deeply.

paragraphs.es: Así concluye la historia de un hombre que, en definitiva, encontró la inmortalidad en sus propias palabras.
paragraphs.en: Thus concludes the story of a man who, ultimately, found immortality in his own words.

questions.question: What did the poet's work reflect?
options: The sorrows of an entire generation

questions.question: What did he search for until his final days?
options: The exact word for every emotion

questions.question: What did his last poem become?
How does the passage describe his legacy?
options: Enduring as long as readers feel deeply

lessons.title: The Debate That Changed a City
lessons.titleNative: El debate que cambió una ciudad
lessons.context: A story combining discourse markers and rhetorical structure.

paragraphs.es: En primer lugar, cabe destacar que nadie esperaba que aquel debate cambiara algo.
paragraphs.en: In the first place, it's worth noting that no one expected that debate to change anything.

paragraphs.es: Sin embargo, escuchándose mutuamente por primera vez, ambos bandos comenzaron a ceder terreno.
paragraphs.en: However, listening to each other for the first time, both sides began to give ground.

paragraphs.es: Cabe preguntarse qué habría ocurrido de no haber existido aquel espacio de diálogo genuino.
paragraphs.en: One might wonder what would have happened had that space for genuine dialogue not existed.

paragraphs.es: En definitiva, aquella conversación, lejos de dividir aún más a la ciudad, terminó por unirla.
paragraphs.en: Ultimately, that conversation, far from dividing the city even further, ended up uniting it.

paragraphs.es: Dicho esto, muchos consideran ese debate como el verdadero punto de inflexión de la historia local.
paragraphs.en: That said, many consider that debate the true turning point in local history.

questions.question: What did no one expect?
options: That the debate would change anything

questions.question: What began to happen as both sides listened to each other?
What did the conversation ultimately do?
How do many people view that debate today?
options: As the true turning point in local history

lessons.title: A Grandmother's Wisdom, Retold
lessons.titleNative: La sabiduría de una abuela, contada de nuevo

paragraphs.es: Mi abuela siempre decía que no hay que darle tantas vueltas a lo que ya no tiene solución.
paragraphs.en: My grandmother always said you shouldn't overthink what no longer has a solution.

paragraphs.es: Sabiendo que la vida está llena de sinsabores, prefería reírse hasta de sus propios fracasos.
paragraphs.en: Knowing life is full of hardships, she preferred to laugh even at her own failures.

paragraphs.es: Cabe destacar que jamás se dio por vencida, ni siquiera cuando la vida le puso entre la espada y la pared.
paragraphs.en: It's worth noting she never gave up, not even when life put her between a rock and a hard place.

paragraphs.es: A raíz de sus enseñanzas, toda la familia aprendió que más vale tarde que nunca.
paragraphs.en: As a result of her teachings, the whole family learned that it's better late than never.

paragraphs.es: Hoy, contando estas historias a mis propios hijos, mantengo vivo el legado de aquella mujer extraordinaria.
paragraphs.en: Today, telling these stories to my own children, I keep alive the legacy of that extraordinary woman.

questions.question: What did the grandmother say about problems without solutions?
What did she prefer to do, knowing life is full of hardships?
options: Laugh even at her own failures

questions.question: What did the family learn from her teachings?
What is the writer doing today?
options: Telling her stories to their own children

lessons.title: The Scientist's Public Battle
lessons.titleNative: La batalla pública de la científica
lessons.context: A current-affairs style story with formal, argumentative register.

paragraphs.es: Resulta innegable que sus hallazgos desafiaron directamente el consenso científico establecido.
paragraphs.en: It's undeniable that her findings directly challenged the established scientific consensus.

paragraphs.es: Cabe preguntarse por qué tantos colegas, en lugar de debatir los datos, prefirieron atacarla personalmente.
paragraphs.en: One might ask why so many colleagues, instead of debating the data, preferred to attack her personally.

paragraphs.es: No obstante las críticas, jamás cedió, sabiendo que la evidencia terminaría por respaldarla.
paragraphs.en: Despite the criticism, she never gave in, knowing the evidence would eventually support her.

paragraphs.es: Con el paso del tiempo, otros investigadores confirmaron, uno tras otro, sus controvertidas conclusiones.
paragraphs.en: Over time, other researchers confirmed, one after another, her controversial conclusions.

paragraphs.es: En definitiva, su perseverancia demostró que la verdad científica, tarde o temprano, siempre sale a la luz.
paragraphs.en: Ultimately, her perseverance proved that scientific truth, sooner or later, always comes to light.

questions.question: What did her findings challenge?
How did many colleagues react instead of debating the data?
What did she know despite the criticism?
options: That the evidence would eventually support her

questions.question: What did her perseverance ultimately prove?
options: That scientific truth always comes to light eventually

lessons.title: An Actor's Unexpected Lesson
lessons.titleNative: La lección inesperada de un actor
lessons.context: A story blending humor, irony, and reflection.

paragraphs.es: Con su característico sarcasmo, el actor bromeaba constantemente sobre sus propios fracasos tempranos.
paragraphs.en: With his characteristic sarcasm, the actor constantly joked about his own early failures.

paragraphs.es: Vaya, qué ironía, decía, que mi primer papel fuera el de un actor terrible dentro de la obra.
paragraphs.en: What irony, he would say, that my first role was that of a terrible actor within the play.

paragraphs.es: Riendo de sí mismo, reconocía que aquellos primeros años lo habían hecho mucho más humilde.
paragraphs.en: Laughing at himself, he acknowledged that those early years had made him much more humble.

paragraphs.es: Cabe destacar que su capacidad de reírse de sus propios errores lo hizo entrañable para el público.
paragraphs.en: It's worth noting that his ability to laugh at his own mistakes made him endearing to the audience.

paragraphs.es: Hoy, contando esas anécdotas con humor autocrítico, sigue conectando profundamente con nuevas generaciones.
paragraphs.en: Today, telling those anecdotes with self-deprecating humor, he continues to connect deeply with new generations.

questions.question: What did the actor joke about?
What was ironic about his first role?
options: It was playing a terrible actor

questions.question: What did those early years do to him?
How does he still connect with new generations?

lessons.title: The Translator's Dilemma
lessons.context: A reflective story about language and meaning.

paragraphs.es: El traductor sabía que ciertos modismos, como "meter la pata", jamás se traducirían literalmente sin perder su gracia.
paragraphs.en: The translator knew that certain idioms, like "meter la pata," would never translate literally without losing their charm.

paragraphs.es: Cabe destacar que su trabajo no consistía solo en cambiar palabras, sino en trasladar todo un mundo cultural.
paragraphs.en: It's worth noting that his job wasn't just changing words, but transferring an entire cultural world.

paragraphs.es: De no captar el humor negro del autor original, la traducción habría resultado plana y sin vida.
paragraphs.en: Had he not captured the original author's dark humor, the translation would have turned out flat and lifeless.

paragraphs.es: Trabajando durante meses en un solo capítulo, logró finalmente encontrar el equilibrio perfecto.
paragraphs.en: Working for months on a single chapter, he finally managed to find the perfect balance.

paragraphs.es: En definitiva, un buen traductor es, en cierto modo, un escritor invisible detrás de cada gran obra.
paragraphs.en: Ultimately, a good translator is, in a way, an invisible writer behind every great work.

questions.question: What did the translator know about certain idioms?
options: They would lose their charm if translated literally

questions.question: What did his job really consist of?
What would have happened if he hadn't captured the dark humor?
options: The translation would be flat and lifeless

questions.question: How does the passage describe a good translator?
options: An invisible writer behind every great work
A poor substitute for the author

lessons.title: The Town That Learned to Laugh Again
lessons.titleNative: El pueblo que aprendió a reír de nuevo
lessons.context: A story about resilience and humor after hardship.

paragraphs.es: Tras la tragedia, muchos pensaron que aquel pueblo jamás volvería a reír con la misma naturalidad.
paragraphs.en: After the tragedy, many thought that town would never laugh with the same ease again.

paragraphs.es: Sin embargo, sabiendo que el humor también puede sanar, algunos vecinos organizaron una pequeña obra de teatro cómica.
paragraphs.en: However, knowing that humor can also heal, some neighbors organized a small comedic play.

paragraphs.es: Al principio, reírse parecía casi un acto de traición hacia quienes habían sufrido tanto.
paragraphs.en: At first, laughing seemed almost an act of betrayal toward those who had suffered so much.

paragraphs.es: Poco a poco, sin embargo, aquellas carcajadas compartidas se convirtieron en el primer paso hacia la sanación colectiva.
paragraphs.en: Little by little, however, those shared bursts of laughter became the first step toward collective healing.

paragraphs.es: Hoy, aquel pueblo celebra cada año un festival de comedia en honor a quienes ya no están.
paragraphs.en: Today, that town celebrates a comedy festival every year in honor of those who are no longer there.

questions.question: What did many people think after the tragedy?
options: The town would never laugh the same way again

questions.question: What did some neighbors organize?
What did laughing feel like at first?
What does the town do today?
options: Celebrates a comedy festival every year

lessons.title: The Advanced Speaker's Reflection
lessons.context: A capstone reflective story reviewing C1's key grammar in context.

paragraphs.es: El dominar un idioma, en definitiva, es aprender a pensar con una lógica distinta a la propia.
paragraphs.en: Mastering a language, ultimately, is learning to think with a logic different from your own.

paragraphs.es: Cabe destacar que cada modismo, cada ironía y cada matiz literario cuenta una parte de la historia de un pueblo.
paragraphs.en: It's worth noting that every idiom, every irony, and every literary nuance tells part of a people's story.

paragraphs.es: De no haberte aventurado más allá de la gramática básica, jamás habrías descubierto tanta riqueza cultural.
paragraphs.en: Had you not ventured beyond basic grammar, you would never have discovered so much cultural richness.

paragraphs.es: No cabe duda de que ahora posees las herramientas para comprender no solo palabras, sino también silencios e insinuaciones.
paragraphs.en: There is no doubt that you now possess the tools to understand not just words, but also silences and insinuations.

paragraphs.es: En definitiva, ya no estudias español: lo habitas, lo sientes y, en cierto modo, lo eres.
paragraphs.en: Ultimately, you no longer study Spanish: you inhabit it, feel it, and, in a way, you are it.

questions.question: What does mastering a language ultimately mean?
options: Learning to think with a different logic

questions.question: What does every idiom and literary nuance tell?
What would have been missed without venturing beyond basic grammar?
How does the passage describe the reader's relationship with Spanish now?
options: They inhabit it and feel it
